scope: Implement minimal AlphaEdit writer adapter, technical qualification, small pilot, then one new cold sequential chain through 2000 edits; no additional user confirmation between these authorized stages.

inherits.precedence: This new task changes owner/server and writer as explicitly specified. Parent server4 ownership or MEMIT-H solve is not inherited for this new chain.

main.stream: same fixed CounterFact first2000, same ordered occurrences
main.start: fresh W0/H0 after separate pilot; do not continue from ridge W/H

planner.summary: All candidate layers subject joint local-z; native prompts/NLL/full-vocab KL current||entry; shared relative budget .75; EfficiencyAdam; request-local 25 evaluations/24 updates and native Jr stop; last evaluated finite candidate; existing dtype/anchor/context reductions retained.
planner.claim: Adaptive task improvement under shared relative budget; not direct AlphaEdit/history-cost optimization.

writer.projector: Same native five-layer baseline projector, threshold, C0 provenance and physical-layer mapping; fixed per layer, no unrequested rebuild each batch.
writer.residual: R_l = z_virtual_l - h_current_l; no remaining-layer divisor
writer.keys: Fresh native mean K_l and canonical full-block h_current_l under own branch lower-layer actual writes; upper keys/residuals cannot be shared across writer branches.
writer.solve: X = solve(Pi_l @ (K_l @ K_l.T + H_l) + L2 * I, Pi_l @ K_l @ R_l.T); Llama U = X.T, then native shape/cast/add.
writer.precision: Native AlphaEdit FP32 operator and multiplication order; certify same-input parity. Do not silently symmetrize, replace with Cholesky, or promote to FP64.
writer.history: After all layer writes, recapture own final model native keys and append K_final @ K_final.T once per layer; preserve existing final-key history storage policy.

qualification.pilot: Existing disjoint stream[2000:2004], IDs [541,6693,16935,17306], BS2x2, cold independent pilot. Reuse compatible existing source/CPU evidence; run new native AlphaEdit operator and actual-model technical checks.
checks: physical projector layer slots and input asset hashes
finite outputs, solve residual, actual applied-weight direction, rollback and observer non-mutation
fresh upper keys and exactly one final-key history append
qualification.main_after_technical_pass: Submit/release automatically within approved resource limits; low ACC/PS/NS, layer concentration or KKT is record-only.

B1_writer_comparison.scope: One same-plan ridge vs AlphaEdit observation inside B1 if technically supported; no second plan fit, no extra full sequential arm, no candidate or coefficient selection.
B1_writer_comparison.contract: Fork common W0/H0 with same terminal plan and anchors; each writer uses own sequential upper K/h/R. Restore exact W/H/RNG after temporary ridge branch; retain AlphaEdit B1 as main continuation.
B1_writer_comparison.feasibility: If exact temporary rollback or memory admission cannot be certified, report probe unavailable and proceed with qualified main; do not redesign or make this a scientific promotion gate.
B1_writer_comparison.later_batches: Replan on AlphaEdit own W/H; do not reuse absolute targets from a diverged ridge chain.

evaluation.per_batch: pre/post current R/P/N; same endpoint observations reused
metrics: TF token micro and prompt macro ACC
mechanism: own-layer target residual error at mean/canonical/context keys
plan versus applied direct displacement error and shares
total relative applied displacement and weight update norm
evaluation.comparison: Reuse qualified v12 ridge, MEMIT-H, AlphaEdit and AlphaEdit-BLUE historical artifacts at matched sample/endpoint; explicitly label runtime/evaluator differences. No extra baseline runs or coefficient sweeps automatically.

resources.project_cap: current server3 cap or stricter; never increase
resources.memory_and_CPU: Use existing admitted server3 defaults and explicit walltime/export policy; fresh resource check.
resources.queue: Register pilot -> technical READY-gated main -> CPU collector with released valid dependencies. If occupied, use scheduler PENDING/dependencies rather than wait for free GPU.
resources.existing_jobs: This instruction does not cancel or replace existing v12 ridge or unrelated jobs; serialize within caps.

delivery.GH: Publish exact method delta and execution instruction, directly assign to SH3 and obtain owner ACK.
delivery.SH3: Implement in dedicated task namespace/worktree, update own method delta/TeX and experiment provenance, submit qualified 2k DAG, return source/config/job IDs and factual stage.
delivery.handoff_stop: GH handoff ends at publication and SH3 direct acceptance; do not wait for 2000-edit completion.
delivery.monitoring: No new recurring monitor or silent retry loop.
